summary: Full backend + frontend testing for BodyIQ-AI Signal Intelligence System rebuild. 18/18 review items verified. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (products catalog with 3 new signal_pack_* SKUs, checkout/session accepts new product_keys with graceful 503 degradation, lead capture for audit_request/report_request/jury_request returns 201 + persists). Frontend: HomePage hero/sub/not-body-language/signal-execution/audiences/signal-products/jury-band/differentiation/navbar all PASS with correct copy. /products/signal-pack 3 tiers + buy buttons render and trigger POST /api/checkout/session with correct product_key. /services/audit form submits → 201 lead with source=audit_request. /services/report and /services/jury pages render with forms. /download/signal-pack (no session_id) shows download-not-granted with audit/report upsell CTAs. Regression: /demo/realtor Scene1→Scene2 in 24s, /preview 200, /founder?key=… 200 (Signal Pack tiers visible in entitlements grid), footer 'BodyIQ-AI' intact. Fixed 2 small bugs found (see action_items).
action_items: RESOLVED (fixed by testing agent): /app/backend/server.py — VALID_SOURCES set was missing 'audit_request', 'report_request', 'jury_request' which made /api/leads return 400 for the 3 new lead-capture pages. Added them to the whitelist. Without this fix, items #10, #11, #12, #16 would all fail.

RESOLVED (fixed by testing agent): /app/frontend/src/pages/DownloadSignalPackPage.jsx line 20 — initial state was `paid: !sessionId` which inverts the spec: visiting /download/signal-pack WITHOUT a session_id was rendering the GRANTED state (Download buttons + 'You're in. Signal Pack Vol. 1') instead of the NotGranted state required by review item #13. Fixed to `paid: false` so NotGranted renders by default and only flips to Granted after polling /api/checkout/status confirms payment_status=paid.
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx is now ~700+ lines after the rebuild. Recommend extracting the AUDIENCES + SIGNAL_PRODUCTS data arrays and each major <section> into /components/home/* (HeroSection, NotBodyLanguageSection, SignalExecutionSection, AudiencesSection, SignalProductsSection, DifferentiationSection) for maintainability — non-blocking.

DownloadSignalPackPage initial-state inversion bug (paid: !sessionId) is the kind of issue that better unit testing of state initialization would catch. Consider adding a small test that asserts `paid:false` whenever `sessionId` is null/undefined.

VALID_SOURCES whitelist requires manual maintenance every time a new lead-capture page is added. Consider deriving it from a single source of truth (e.g., LeadSource enum) shared across pages and validation.
Stripe graceful 503 path is working as designed (returns detail mentioning STRIPE_API_KEY missing). Once Live Keys land tomorrow, re-test items #9 and #15 to confirm 200 + checkout URL.

Three new pages (AuditPage, ReportPage, JuryPage) share a near-identical lead-capture form pattern. A reusable <LeadCaptureForm source=… title=… fields=…/> component would remove ~150 LOC of duplication.
test_credentials: Founder bypass /founder?key=jeffrey-2026-bodyiq-founder-master verified — auto-grants all 9 entitlements including the 3 new Signal Pack tiers visible in portal grid.
seed_data_creation: TEST_*@example.com leads created in DB across audit_request, report_request, jury_request, home sources via pytest. Cleanup not performed (data is harmless, prefixed TEST_ for easy purge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 18 items pass after 2 small fixes (VALID_SOURCES whitelist + DownloadSignalPackPage initial state). Stripe Live Keys still NOT in .env — checkout/session returns 503 by design. Once keys land, re-run iter9 pytest TestCheckoutSession block; current expectation accepts both 200 and 503. The /download/signal-pack page now correctly shows download-not-granted without session_id and would need a real Stripe session_id with payment_status=paid to render the Granted state. Realtor demo prefetch + autoplay still takes ~22-25s for Scene1→Scene2 (consistent with iter8). HomePage now has 9 main testid sections; use them as anchors for any future visual diff regression.
rca of the issue: Two implementation misses: (1) Server.py PRODUCTS dict was extended with 3 new signal_pack_* keys but VALID_SOURCES set on line 250 was not updated to allow the 3 new lead-capture sources — this would have returned 400 on every Audit/Report/Jury form submission. (2) DownloadSignalPackPage useState initialized `paid: !sessionId` (inverted boolean) — likely a copy-paste flip between 'loading' and 'paid' fields. Both fixed; both verified with live test.
